sections.heading: Contacting us
sections.body: This website currently uses email and WhatsApp links instead of contact forms. Clicking an email link opens your email app; it does not send a message automatically. We receive the information you choose to send when you send your message.

sections.heading: How we use your message
sections.body: We use your contact details and the information in your message to respond and discuss your project. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Website preferences and technical data
sections.body: The site remembers your language preference in a cookie. It does not collect project briefs, capture email addresses, or save enquiry drafts in the browser. The site does not load an analytics tracker. Hosting providers may process basic connection data to serve and secure the site.

sections.heading: External services
sections.body: WhatsApp, social platforms and your email provider handle information under their own privacy policies when you use their services.

sections.heading: Your information
sections.body: For questions about your information, or requests to access, correct or delete it, email abdullah@muse.sa.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By using this website, you agree to these terms. If you don't agree, please don't use the site.

sections.heading: Use of this site
sections.body: This site is provided for the purpose of learning about Muse Studios and getting in touch about potential work. You agree not to misuse the site or interfere with its normal operation.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: All content on this site, including the Muse Studios name, logo, and design, is the property of Muse Studios and may not be reproduced without permission.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: This site is provided as-is, without warranties of any kind, express or implied.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the site after changes means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to abdullah@muse.sa.
